decisions.reason: Report connects client.js's top-level ESM import to the boot log's single classic-script combo and the browser compile error at position 1:1, explains one early syntax error stops the whole combo from compiling so no entries register, identifies dsh-typert-registry as merely the first awaited innocent entry, and notes ESM remains valid in other loading contexts (author in ESM, ship a bundled artifact).

Gives bisect of the patch insert rows, a cheap static grep for top-level import/export plus classic-script parsing of the suspect bundle, and fully describes the window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory}) wrapper with id equal to the package name, host-provided React via require inside the factory, and module.exports returning apply/inject.

Uses plugin-apply-error.txt to explain the slot is declared by the owning parent entry and apply order is unguaranteed, shows the exact ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', () => ctx.slots.register(...)) deferred wrapper, and correctly restricts registrant fields to name/id/order (+label) while forbidding declaration-owned kind/scope.

Grounded in host-boot-log.txt/restart-notes.txt: the combo is composed once at boot with no watcher, so edits and refresh change nothing; prescribes full stop/restart per iteration with taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F for the Windows tree and explains EADDRINUSE as the orphaned old process holding the port, not a packaging defect.

Proposes per-bundle classic-script validation at assembly and culprit-naming attribution at combo failure instead of blaming the first awaited entry, plus an authoring checklist covering the loader factory with host React via require, inject/apply exports, deferred cross-entry slot registration with allowed fields, and restart/Windows process-tree cleanup.

caps.reason: The report never endorses bare top-level ESM in the combo, never drops slots.inject in favor of immediate cross-entry registration, explicitly forbids kind/scope on registrants, and insists on a full host restart rather than HMR or browser refresh; bad forms appear only as diagnosed defects.
